title: Test drives and diagnostic vehicle tests
summary: This topic combines customer impressions from test drives with service diagnostic test procedures, so the examples do not form a single consistent issue area.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention favorable driving impressions such as power, pickup, fit, and overall upgrade satisfaction, plus diagnostic tests that found no faults.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe diagnostic work around audio or fault-memory checks where test procedures were performed but the issue remained unresolved or tied to a faulty component.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly state that a test drive or vehicle test occurred, or note comparative impressions without a clear overall sentiment about the topic itself.

limitations: The cluster mixes customer test-drive impressions with workshop diagnostic phrases such as performing vehicle tests and reading faults.
Many examples are procedural or comparative statements without enough context to determine clear sentiment.
Samples are stratified and not representative, so they should not be used to infer how common any issue or experience is.
